materials.title: 2016年 考研英语一 Reading Part A Text 1
materials.text:
Institutional scholarship on technological transitions in 2016 highlights the tension between established operational paradigms and emerging innovations. Throughout economic history, mature industries have repeatedly underestimated the disruptive velocity of novel delivery architectures. When legacy organizations prioritize short-term revenue protection, they frequently forfeit strategic positioning in emerging market sectors.

Moreover, empirical case studies reveal that organizational adaptability requires more than incremental capital expenditure; it demands a comprehensive realignment of incentives, research workflows, and talent development across all operational tiers.

materials.title: 2016年 考研英语一 Reading Part A Text 2
materials.text:
Scientific inquiry relies on reproducible methodology and rigorous peer appraisal to validate empirical claims. Over the past decade, open-data initiatives have introduced greater transparency across experimental biology and social sciences. Researchers now routinely deposit raw instrumentation outputs into public repositories, enabling independent global verification.

By standardizing metadata protocols and preregistering experimental designs, scholarly communities have curbed selective reporting and strengthened public confidence in empirical findings.

materials.title: 2016年 考研英语一 Part C 英译汉全文语境
materials.text:
The historical evolution of scientific institutions reveals an ongoing dialogue between philosophical epistemology and practical technological application. (46) <u>Scholars have long recognized that theoretical breakthroughs in natural philosophy frequently originate from attempts to resolve concrete engineering dilemmas in everyday commerce.</u> When researchers examine historical industrial transitions, they discover that formal laboratory experiments and artisanal workshop traditions were mutually reinforcing.

(47) <u>Early modern academies established systematic protocols for recording experimental observations, ensuring that claims could be independently scrutinized by international contemporaries.</u> This collective scrutiny transformed idiosyncratic discoveries into cumulative public knowledge.

(48) <u>Technological advancement accelerated when mathematical analysis was applied directly to mechanical design, replacing craft intuition with quantifiable engineering principles.</u> As manufacturing operations grew in complexity, specialized technical institutions emerged to train practitioners in both rigorous theory and empirical methodology.

(49) <u>Governments recognized that sustaining national prosperity required continuous public investment in foundational scientific research that private enterprises could not profitably underwrite.</u> Consequently, national academies and research universities assumed a central stewardship role in preserving scientific infrastructure.

(50) <u>In the contemporary era, the boundary between pure scientific inquiry and applied technological development has become increasingly permeable and collaborative.</u> Maintaining this vibrant scientific ecosystem requires sustained public trust, ethical responsibility, and international open exchange.

rubric.referenceText:
Notice
December 26, 2015
Welcome to our university! As a librarian, I would like to provide you with detailed information as regards our library.
To begin with, just like all the major libraries in our country, we have used computers connected to the Internet to streamline our retrieval system. In addition, we have already replaced all the outdated facilities, as a convenience to readers. Last but not least, we have extended the opening hours of our library by 4 hours.
We are happy to have you here in our university. I am sure you will have a wonderful time here.
Li Ming

rubric.referenceText:
The above two pictures reveal two fathers' different teaching methods. In the first picture, the father is urging his son to study hard while he is smoking and watching TV idly. In the second picture, the father and his son are both concentrating on their study. The caption under the cartoon reads: "It is better to set an example than to make demands".
Apparently, the author of the cartoon focuses on a fact that many parents when educating their children tend to neglect the impact of their own acts upon their children. It is without any doubt that all parents hope that their children could have a bright future. Therefore, they tend to count on schools and the society to provide their kids with a good education. However, what they don't realize is that parents are the first teachers of children. Parents failing to set a role model for their children will only result in an unhealthy family atmosphere, which is definitely harmful to the future development of their children.
From my perspective, education from parents is of vital importance to a child's healthy growth. Therefore, parents should provide their children with a favorable growing environment by being a positive role model. Only through persistent efforts and proper guidance can children enjoy a bright future.
